purpose: Company-facing early-warning and strategic-interpretation layer for the 14-theme research atlas

records.title: AI changes workplace control before it settles productivity
records.summary: AI is changing workplace control before shared productivity is proven.
records.open_test: Named-employer implementation ledger linking AI exposure to worker and household outcomes

records.title: Consumer recourse is visible before it is effective
records.summary: Complaint and response records make problems visible before verified remedy or exit.
records.open_test: Essential-service case record from initial contact through verified remedy and practical exit

records.title: Geopolitical capability creates a permission gap before it creates leverage
records.summary: Operational capability and formal response can precede durable public permission or leverage.
records.open_test: Incident-country-party ledger linking capability, response, burden, permission, recovery, and later behavior

records.title: Language technology creates visibility before it creates vitality
records.summary: Language AI can improve representation without yet producing repeated use, trust, or cultural vitality.
records.open_test: Stable Gazetteer crosswalk plus repeated use and completed tasks in a real workflow

records.title: Infrastructure capacity creates a bargain before it creates reliable benefit
records.summary: Capacity, revenue, and readiness appear before reliable user benefit and burden are proven.
records.open_test: Identifier-bearing project record from approval through operation, user receipt, burden, maintenance, and exit

records.title: Financial pressure creates navigation work before it creates visible demand change
records.summary: Household pressure can increase search and substitution before a simple demand collapse appears.
records.open_test: Transaction or household-panel link from search episode to completion, payment, recovery, and exit

records.title: Material pressure becomes political meaning through attribution and practical room
records.summary: Hardship is interpreted through trust, identity, belonging, and efficacy before it becomes action.
records.open_test: Dated encounter ledger from condition through attribution, remedy, later action, and non-use

promotion_requirements: business exposure labeled as evidence or hypothesis
